author: ABMN Staff
title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for December, 11th (AAPL, ACRX, CNI, CNR, FCF, GWPH, JAZZ, LULU, NCSM, PFE)
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Dec 11th, 2018 // No Comments
Investment Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Tuesday, December 11th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $210.00 target price by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
AcelRx Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:ACRX) was given a $9.00 price target by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock. The analysts wrote, “. Post ACRX’s analyst day in NYC, we reiterate our Overweight rating and 12-month price target of $9. Despite Dsuvia approval on the large market opportunity ahead for the pain product, we believe the market continues to undervalue ACRX stock. The KOL’s in attendance today were very positive on their willingness to use Dsuvia in their respective emergency rooms and/or surgery centers, underscoring our positive thesis for Dsuvia’s prospects.””
Canadian National Railway (NYSE:CNI) (TSE:CNR) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Raymond James.
China Metro Rural (NYSEMKT:CNR) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Raymond James. They currently have a $125.00 target price on the stock.
First Commonwealth Financial (NYSE:FCF) had its hold rating reissued by analysts at Raymond James.
Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. began coverage on shares of GW Pharmaceuticals PLC- (NASDAQ:GWPH) . They issued a hold rating and a $142.00 target price on the stock.
Oppenheimer Holdings Inc. assumed coverage on shares of Jazz Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:JAZZ) . The firm issued a buy rating and a $180.00 target price on the stock.
Lululemon Athletica (NASDAQ:LULU) was given a $185.00 price target by analysts at Cowen Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
NCS Multistage (NASDAQ:NCSM) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. Cantor Fitzgerald currently has a $53.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We reiterate our OW and think respectable earnings growth, driven by Innovative Medicines, pipeline advancements, and return of capital to PFE’s shareholders — above the industry average — are all underappreciated. Therefore, we believe multiple expansion and upward earnings revisions should drive PFE shares higher. Valuation Summary We use a blend of DCF and multiples (EV/EBITDA) analysis to get to our 12-month price target of $53.””
